implementation.maintenance: Existing compiled usage:reconcile, cleanup:retention and conditional assets:cleanup only, same API env, session advisory exclusivity, bounded retries/timeouts, durable atomic status, heartbeat and capped status-only alerts. DB lock loss and state IO failure close clients and exit. No generation/claim/provider command.
implementation.backups: Separate SELECT-only credential and independent private key; consistent PG16 snapshot streamed into AES-256-GCM with authenticated metadata, exclusive publication, full authentication and pg_restore list verification. Daily local backups and seven-day retention; standalone hourly pruning has no DB/key dependency and serializes concurrent deletion with a local OS-backed SQLite lock.
implementation.restore: Full authentication before target connection; explicit prefix+ack, owned empty private DB with no other clients and no CONNECT for PUBLIC/other roles. Single transaction without clean/overwrite. Always RESTORED_QUARANTINED with financialContinuity UNVERIFIED; no application/provider replay or auto-release.
implementation.deployment: Separate opt-in operations image/profile overlay, production defaults, nonroot/readonly/cap-drop/resource limits/no Docker socket, separate private external volumes. Original closed API/PG service behavior preserved.
implementation.budgets: No provider provisioning, cloud deployment, paid service, external notification or additional model. Actual free-host capacity/cost not certified.
